Can be fractional (materials accumulate exactly, only display formatting rounds); scaled later purely by upgrades, not by RNG.

label: Quests: over-level attempt penalty (% per level)

Sending on a quest above your level is allowed (only auto-queue/pickBestQuest still restricts itself to quests a hero already qualifies for) -- this is what makes doing so a real trade rather than a free pass. 10 means a hero 3 levels under a quest's reqLevel loses 30 percentage points of success attempting it, on top of everything else. Existing MIN_SUCCESS/MAX_SUCCESS clamps (5-95) still apply, so it's always technically attemptable, never literally impossible or free.

label: Quest reroll: base gold cost

label: Quest reroll: cost growth per paid reroll

label: Vendor reroll: base gold cost

label: Vendor reroll: cost growth per paid reroll

label: Elemental: per-element tag roll chance (%)
description: Independent chance for each candidate element to actually appear on a quest offer, checked once per element up to that tier's own ceiling (see rollElementTags in elements.ts). At 22%, Easy/Normal (max 1 tag) land ~37% zero tags / 63% one; Hard/Epic/Legendary (max 2-3) land ~37% zero / 41% one / 21% two-or-more -- verified at runtime across 2000 samples per tier.

label: Elemental: success bonus per matching tag (%)

Deliberately modest (a nice-to-have, not a build-around), and stacks per matching tag if an offer carries more than one.

label: Scrap yield: Uncommon item

label: Scrap yield: Rare item

label: Scrap yield: Epic item

label: Scrap yield: Legendary item

label: Shop: buyback price markup
description: Multiplier on what an item sold for, when buying it back from the Blacksmith's own buyback list -- always MORE than the sale price, never less, so reversing a sale costs something rather than being a free undo (or, stacked with a second sale, a way to print gold). See ShopManager.sell/buyBack.

label: Shop: buyback list max entries
description: How many recently-sold items the Blacksmith's buyback list remembers at once -- oldest entry drops off (sold for good, no longer reversible) once a new sale would exceed this.

label: Quests: daily first-burst guaranteed gold
description: Guaranteed MINIMUM gold on the first burst-mode quest each hero resolves per calendar day (tracked via Hero.lastBurstBonusDay) -- a floor (Math.max), not a multiplier. A multiplier was tried first and rejected: it multiplies whatever the roll already produced, so a FAILED first burst (which can legitimately pay 0 after the failure-payout reduction) stayed at 0 no matter the multiplier, defeating the entire point. A flat guaranteed minimum instead means the first burst of the day always pays out something solid regardless of success/failure or how badly the cap/floor crushed the underlying roll. Safe to be generous (this is a fairly solid number for a 2-8 minute task) because it cannot be farmed -- it fires at most once per hero per day regardless of roster size or how many quests get sent.

label: Quests: daily first-burst guaranteed xp
description: Same shape as quest.dailyBurstBonusGold, for XP.

label: Quests: critical burst chance (%)
description: Chance, per successful quest, of a Critical Burst -- gold and xp both multiplied by quest.critMultiplier, with its own distinct celebration in the result modal. Independent of (and can stack with) the daily first-burst floor above; deliberately not scaled by any stat so it stays a purely random spike rather than another thing to optimize.

label: Quests: critical burst multiplier

label: Vendor level: base cost
description: Gold cost of a vendor's first level.

label: Vendor level: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level to a vendor's level-up cost.

label: Early-tier discount: level 0
description: Fraction of full price a guild's very first purchase of anything costs (applies to every leveled cost formula in the game).

label: Early-tier discount: level 1
description: Fraction of full price the second purchase of a given leveled item costs.

label: Early-tier discount: level 2
description: Fraction of full price the third purchase of a given leveled item costs.

label: Early-tier discount: level 3
description: Fraction of full price the fourth purchase of a given leveled item costs. Level 4+ is always full price (1.0), not itself a tuning entry.

label: Health: Max Health base
description: Flat baseline added before the endurance/level terms in HeroManager.maxHealth -- see guild-idler-status.md's Health stat + Fallen/death mechanic section.

label: Health: Max Health endurance coefficient
description: Multiplies sqrt(endurance) in HeroManager.maxHealth, same sqrt(endurance) shape statMods already uses for injuryResist.

label: Health: Max Health level coefficient
description: Flat Max Health granted per hero level in HeroManager.maxHealth.

label: Health: damage % per injury duration-hour
description: Health damage on injury, as a percent of Max Health, is derived as durationHours * this value rather than authored per-injury -- see items.ts's healthDamagePercentForInjury. Self-corrects if an injury's durationHours ever changes.

label: Health: success penalty per missing Health %
description: Success-chance points lost per percentage point of Health missing, folded into heroMods the same way injuryMods already is. A hero at low Health is worse odds, never unsendable -- there is no hard gate.

label: Health: on-quest regen fraction
description: Passive Health regen rate while a hero is actively out on a quest, as a fraction of the current idle regen rate. Scales down automatically as Infirmary shrinks the idle heal time too.

label: Fallen: revival cost base
description: Flat gold cost floor for instantly (pay-to-skip) reviving a Fallen hero, before the per-level term. See fallen.revivalCostPerLevel.

label: Fallen: revival cost per hero level
description: Gold added per hero level to the instant-revive cost -- same shape as treatmentCost scaling with injury severity, here scaling with hero level instead.

label: Vitality Training: base cost
description: Approximates an original 50/100/200/500g target as closely as the shared earlyTierDiscount-based upgradeCost formula allows -- see guild-idler-status.md's Health-related gold sinks entry.

label: Vitality Training: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

label: Vitality Training: max level
description: Highest level Vitality Training can reach.

label: Vitality Training: Max Health per level
description: Flat Max Health granted per level, guild-wide (applies to every hero via the standard equipmentMods-style flat health bonus).

label: Undertaker's Favor: base cost
description: A cheap early/mid-game upgrade discounting the paid instant-revive path -- deliberately separate from Infirmary's free-auto-revive-at-max-level, so pay-it-down and wait-it-out are two independent investment targets.

label: Undertaker's Favor: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

label: Undertaker's Favor: max level
description: Highest level Undertaker's Favor can reach.

label: Undertaker's Favor: revival discount % per level
description: Percentage points shaved off the paid instant-revive cost per level, up to 30% at max level.

label: Vital Legacy: base Renown cost
description: Same starting shape as the other tier-1 Renown Perks (Renowned Skill etc.).

label: Vital Legacy: Renown cost growth
description: Matches Renowned Skill's own growth rate.

label: Vital Legacy: max level (tier 1)
description: Matches Renowned Skill's own tier-1 cap.

label: Vital Legacy: Max Health per level
description: Same +5/level increment as Vitality Training on purpose -- same shape, different game-stage (this is the late-game renown/ascension-loop version, not a replacement for the early upgrade).

label: Vital Legacy: max level (tier 2)
description: Matches Renowned Skill's own tier-2 cap.

label: Vital Legacy: tier 2 starting Renown cost
description: Matches Renowned Skill's own tier-2 starting cost.

label: Vital Legacy: tier 2 Renown cost growth
description: Matches Renowned Skill's own tier-2 growth rate.

label: Health: bulk revive discount
description: Fraction knocked off the summed individual revival costs when using Revive All instead of reviving each Fallen hero one at a time.

label: Kennel: base cost
description: Same starting shape as Infirmary -- a fully separate facility, not a reuse of it.

label: Kennel: cost growth
description: Matches Infirmary's own growth rate.

label: Kennel: max level
description: Highest level Kennel can reach -- same 5-level shape as Infirmary.

label: Kennel: base heal time (minutes)
description: Minutes for a pet to fully heal Health with no Kennel levels bought yet.

label: Kennel: heal-time reduction per level (minutes)
description: Minutes shaved off the pet heal time per Kennel level.

label: Kennel: minimum heal time (minutes)
description: Floor on pet heal time -- reached at Kennel's max level.

label: Kennel: free auto-revive time (hours)
description: Hours until a Fallen pet is automatically revived for free, once Kennel has reached its max level. Below max level there is no free auto-revive at all.

label: Physician's Charity: base cost
description: Cost of the first (level 0) Physician's Charity upgrade.

label: Physician's Charity: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

label: Physician's Charity: max level
description: Highest level Physician's Charity can reach.

label: Physician's Charity: free Treats per day per level
description: How many free (0 gold) Treat actions per calendar day, guild-wide, per level. Level 5 = 5 free Treats/day.

label: Smith's Charity: base cost
description: Cost of the first (level 0) Smith's Charity upgrade.

label: Smith's Charity: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level, before the early-tier discount.

label: Smith's Charity: max level
description: Highest level Smith's Charity can reach.

label: Smith's Charity: free Repairs per day per level
description: How many free (0 gold) Repair actions per calendar day, guild-wide, per level. Level 5 = 5 free Repairs/day.

label: Companion Vitality: base cost
description: Same shape as Vitality Training -- a fully separate upgrade, not a reuse of it.

label: Companion Vitality: cost growth
description: Matches Vitality Training's own growth rate.

label: Companion Vitality: max level
description: Matches Vitality Training's own level cap.

label: Companion Vitality: pet Max Health per level
description: Same +5/level as Vitality Training, applied to petHealth instead of health.

label: Kennel Keeper's Favor: base cost
description: Same shape as Undertaker's Favor -- a fully separate upgrade.

label: Kennel Keeper's Favor: cost growth
description: Matches Undertaker's Favor's own growth rate.

label: Kennel Keeper's Favor: max level
description: Matches Undertaker's Favor's own level cap.

label: Kennel Keeper's Favor: pet revival discount % per level
description: Same 6%/level, 30% max shape as Undertaker's Favor, applied to petRevivalDiscount instead.

label: Companion Legacy: base Renown cost
description: Same starting shape as Vital Legacy.

label: Companion Legacy: Renown cost growth
description: Matches Vital Legacy's own growth rate.

label: Companion Legacy: max level (tier 1)
description: Matches Vital Legacy's own tier-1 cap.

label: Companion Legacy: pet Max Health per level
description: Same +5/level as Vital Legacy, applied to petHealth instead of health.

label: Companion Legacy: max level (tier 2)
description: Matches Vital Legacy's own tier-2 cap.

label: Companion Legacy: tier 2 starting Renown cost
description: Matches Vital Legacy's own tier-2 starting cost.

label: Companion Legacy: tier 2 Renown cost growth
description: Matches Vital Legacy's own tier-2 growth rate.

label: Pets: Max Health base
description: Flat baseline for PetManager.maxHealth -- roughly half a fresh hero's own baseline, since a pet is an auxiliary companion, not the one taking the brunt of a fight.

label: Pets: Max Health per pet-level
description: Flat Max Health granted per pet level (PetManager.levelForXp's flat curve, not a hero's exponential one).

label: Pets: revival cost base
description: Smaller scale than a hero's own fallen.revivalCostBase -- reviving a companion costs less than reviving a hero.

label: Pets: revival cost per pet-level
description: Gold added per pet level to the instant-revive cost.

label: Pets: bulk revive discount
description: Same 10% shape as health.bulkReviveDiscount, for reviving every Fallen pet at once.

label: Grimsby: min quests between visits
description: Lower bound of the randomized non-burst-quest threshold rolled each time Grimsby leaves (see PeddlerManager.rollThreshold).

label: Grimsby: max quests between visits
description: Upper bound of the randomized non-burst-quest threshold rolled each time Grimsby leaves.

label: Grimsby: leaves if ignored after (ms)
description: Real-time window after arrival before Grimsby packs up and leaves untouched -- 900000 = 15 minutes.

label: Grimsby: base card-pick fee (gold)
description: Flat gold cost floor for a single Pick Your Card flip, before the per-level scaling below.

label: Grimsby: fee scaling per guild level
description: Gold added to the card-pick fee per level of the guild's highest hero -- see PeddlerManager.feeCost. Deliberately gentle (0.5/level, not a round number) -- verified via direct EV-vs-fee simulation against the real card pool and real equipment values that this keeps the expected-loss ratio reasonably consistent (roughly 0.82 down to 0.49 EV/fee across levels 1-50) rather than swinging from a near-breakeven gamble early to a punishing one late, which a steeper per-level cost produced.

label: Grimsby: tier weight - Bust
description: Relative weight for the Bust tier in the tier-selection roll -- see PeddlerManager.resolveFlip. All five tierWeight.* entries are relative to each other, not independent percentages.

label: Grimsby: tier weight - Refund
description: Relative weight for the Refund tier in the tier-selection roll.

label: Grimsby: tier weight - Modest
description: Relative weight for the Modest tier in the tier-selection roll.

label: Grimsby: tier weight - Good
description: Relative weight for the Good tier in the tier-selection roll.

label: Grimsby: tier weight - Jackpot
description: Relative weight for the Jackpot tier in the tier-selection roll -- deliberately the smallest, per design (rare material/gold/egg/epic gear, no cosmetics).

label: Beckoning Charm: counter reduction
description: Flat amount shaved off questsSinceGrimsby when a Beckoning Charm is used -- see GameEngine.usePeddlerCharm.

label: High Roller: unlock cost
description: One-time gold cost to unlock the High Roller flip on Grimsby's own page. Flat, not per-level -- see GameState.grimsbyHighRollerUnlocked.

label: High Roller: fee/reward multiplier
description: Both the fee and the reward for a High Roller flip are this many times the regular flip's -- see PeddlerManager.resolveFlip.

label: Gathering Bounty: chance per board slot
description: Percent chance each generated quest-board slot rolls as a Gathering Bounty (guaranteed material reward) instead of an ordinary offer. Only rolled once harvestUnlocked is true.

label: Gathering Bounty: material per hour
description: Flat material units granted per hour of a Gathering Bounty's duration on success. Calibrated below the ~50/hr a hero could get manually clicking the Harvest minigame at zero tool investment (45s base spawn interval, 0.5 base yield, 12% chance of a 3x bonus glint) -- a fire-and-forget bounty is meant to pay slightly less than optimal manual play, same 80-85%-of-best-manual-rate shape fastQuestCapsPerHour already uses elsewhere.

label: Quest success: investment linear threshold
description: Raw invested success points (gear + consumables + facilities/renown + spent stat points + elemental + preferred-tag, combined) that still count fully 1:1 before curveInvestment starts diminishing. See QuestManager.previewSuccess/curveInvestment.

label: Quest success: investment diminishing cap (extra)
description: Asymptotic extra success points invested sources can contribute beyond quest.investmentLinearThreshold -- approached but never fully reached (exponential approach, continuous slope at the threshold). Raising this lets heavy investment climb further before diminishing returns bite hard.

label: Quest success: investment diminishing decay
description: Decay constant for the same curve as quest.investmentDiminishingCapExtra -- kept equal to it by default so the curve's slope is exactly 1 right at the threshold (no discontinuous jump). Lower values saturate faster (diminishing returns bite sooner).

label: Easy burst chance: level 1-5
description: Burst-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 1-5 -- unchanged from the original onboarding-hook value. See balance.ts's easyFastModeChances.

label: Easy medium chance: level 1-5
description: Medium-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 1-5 (only rolled if burst didn't hit) -- unchanged from the original value.

label: Easy burst chance: level 6-10
description: Burst-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 6-10 -- first taper step, shifting weight toward Medium as burst's own short duration starts producing trivial absolute rewards under the live per-hour cap.

label: Easy medium chance: level 6-10
description: Medium-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 6-10 -- raised to absorb the share tapered off burst.

label: Easy burst chance: level 11-15
description: Burst-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 11-15 -- burst becomes rare.

label: Easy medium chance: level 11-15
description: Medium-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 11-15.

label: Easy burst chance: level 16+
description: Burst-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 16+ -- retired entirely. Standard/Medium fully take over; see easyFastModeChances and generateContractsForHero's own guard against forcing a burst guarantee once this is 0.

label: Easy medium chance: level 16+
description: Medium-mode chance on Easy offers for a hero at level 16+, absorbing burst's entire retired share.

description: Enchanted Seal's Black Market price discount per level.

label: Apothecary's Discount: consumable discount % per level

label: Arcane Discount: cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level to Arcane Discount's cost.

label: Arcane Discount: max level

label: Arcane Discount: enchant discount % per level
description: Arcane Discount's enchant price discount per level.

label: Trade Favor (Blacksmith): base cost
description: Gold cost of Trade Favor (Blacksmith)'s first level.

label: Trade Favor (Blacksmith): cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level to Trade Favor (Blacksmith)'s cost.

label: Trade Favor (Blacksmith): max level
description: Level cap for Trade Favor (Blacksmith).

label: Trade Favor (Blacksmith): free rerolls per level
description: Trade Favor (Blacksmith)'s free vendor rerolls per day granted per level.

label: Trade Favor (Alchemist): base cost
description: Gold cost of Trade Favor (Alchemist)'s first level.

label: Trade Favor (Alchemist): cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level to Trade Favor (Alchemist)'s cost.

label: Trade Favor (Alchemist): max level
description: Level cap for Trade Favor (Alchemist).

label: Trade Favor (Alchemist): free rerolls per level
description: Trade Favor (Alchemist)'s free vendor rerolls per day granted per level.

label: Trade Favor (Enchanter): base cost
description: Gold cost of Trade Favor (Enchanter)'s first level.

label: Trade Favor (Enchanter): cost growth
description: Multiplier applied per level to Trade Favor (Enchanter)'s cost.

label: Trade Favor (Enchanter): max level
description: Level cap for Trade Favor (Enchanter).

label: Trade Favor (Enchanter): free rerolls per level
description: Trade Favor (Enchanter)'s free vendor rerolls per day granted per level.

label: Role Training: unlock cost (base)
description: Gold cost of training a hero into a role they have never held before, at level 0.

label: Role Training: unlock cost per level
description: Additional gold per hero level, added to the base unlock cost.

label: Role Training: swap cost (base)
description: Gold cost of swapping a hero back to a role they already hold, at level 0. Repeatable, no limit.

label: Role Training: swap cost per level
description: Additional gold per hero level, added to the base swap cost.

label: Raids: role mismatch penalty per unmet slot
description: Flat success-percentage points subtracted per unmet requiredRoles slot at raid start.

label: Balance: gold failure multiplier
description: Fraction of the rolled gold a failed quest still pays out. Matches QuestManager.resolve's actual formula exactly.

label: Balance: xp failure multiplier
description: Fraction of the rolled xp a failed quest still pays out. Matches QuestManager.resolve's actual formula exactly.

label: Balance: base xp min
description: Lower bound of the fixed xp range non-burst quests roll from, before the tier's own xpMultiplier applies.

label: Balance: base xp max
description: Upper bound of the fixed xp range non-burst quests roll from, before the tier's own xpMultiplier applies.

label: Balance: min level for burst/medium cap
description: Below this hero level, burst/medium quests keep their full uncapped reward -- the deliberate onboarding hook.

label: Balance: burst/medium cap fraction
description: Burst/medium's live per-hour reward cap, as a fraction of the best-unlocked tier's own per-hour rate.

label: Progression: skin price
description: Flat gold cost for any purchasable (non-DLC) hero skin.

label: Progression: prestige min level
description: Minimum hero level required for retirement to grant any Renown at all.

label: Progression: prestige streak window (ms)
description: Retiring again within this window of the last retirement extends the streak. 259200000ms = 3 days.

label: Progression: prestige streak bonus per step (%)
description: Percentage bonus to Renown gained, added per step of the current retirement streak.

label: Progression: prestige streak bonus cap (%)
description: Maximum percentage bonus the prestige streak can reach, regardless of streak length.

label: Progression: ascension stat bonus
description: Flat permanent stat bonus granted per ascension level, applied to every stat.

label: Progression: XP curve base coefficient
description: Base multiplier in xpForLevel's level^exponent curve. Was a bare literal before patch 0173; now tunable like every other numeric constant in this file.

label: Progression: XP curve exponent
description: Exponent in xpForLevel's level^exponent curve. Was a bare literal before patch 0173; now tunable like every other numeric constant in this file.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 1 level
description: Below this level, the XP multiplier is a flat 1.0x -- early game is unchanged from the pre-patch-0173 curve.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 1 multiplier
description: XP multiplier at and below breakpoint 1's level.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 2 level
description: Second XP curve breakpoint -- multiplier ramps linearly from breakpoint 1 to here.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 2 multiplier
description: XP multiplier at breakpoint 2's level.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 3 level
description: Third XP curve breakpoint -- multiplier ramps linearly from breakpoint 2 to here.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 3 multiplier
description: XP multiplier at breakpoint 3's level.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 4 level
description: Fourth XP curve breakpoint -- where the endgame slog begins. Deliberately lands at the same level Requiem for the Last God (the final raid) requires.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 4 multiplier
description: XP multiplier at breakpoint 4's level -- the slope noticeably steepens from here to breakpoint 5.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 5 level
description: Fifth and final XP curve breakpoint -- the level cap. Multiplier holds flat at this value for any level above it.

label: XP curve: breakpoint 5 multiplier
description: XP multiplier at the level cap -- the deliberate 'absolute slog' endgame target.
